title: My Dog Max
text:
I have a dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very friendly. I take him for a walk every morning.

Max likes to play with a red ball. He drinks water and eats dog food. At night he sleeps in his bed next to me.

questions.text: What does Max like to play with?
How does the speaker feel about Max?
options: They do not know him well
They want to give him away

questions.text: Why does the speaker take Max for a walk every morning?
options: To keep him healthy and happy

vocabulary.definition: a short trip on foot for exercise or pleasure
kind and pleasant to be with
a clear liquid that people and animals drink

paragraph_translations: Mam psa. Ma na imię Max. Max jest brązowy i bardzo przyjazny. Każdego ranka zabieram go na spacer.
Max lubi bawić się czerwoną piłką. Pije wodę i je karmę dla psów. W nocy śpi w swoim łóżku obok mnie.
